item.title: Tucker Said He Didn't Know If Algebra Was REAL
item.description:
Tucker Carlson went on a whole rant questioning whether algebra is even real. I'm not joking. He's also not sure atomic weapons were invented by humans. This is the same guy who constantly talks about the decline of Western civilization and how China and Russia are beating us in STEM. Tucker, you are the decline. He also contradicted himself on Ben Shapiro's IQ within the same live stream, minutes apart. Keep going, Tucker. You're doing the work for us.
